#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Set DEST (or BACKUP_DEST) to either a mounted directory or host:path.  Keeping
# the default beside this script makes the job usable before an off-host backup
# mount has been configured.
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd -P)
: "${DEST:=${BACKUP_DEST:-$SCRIPT_DIR/backups}}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Use -C so the archive always contains logs/, regardless of cron's cwd.
tar -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" -czf "$BUNDLE" logs

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        # A host:path destination is copied over SSH.
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
    *)
        # A mounted/local destination is a directory and may be created locally.
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
